text: The Wardroom continuity pass is the standard automatic post-meeting routine: validate the Clerk, export the ledger, and refresh the readable packet.

text: Admiral witnessed live audio occur during the active meeting session.
evidence: Admiral direct observation in Chat Client
captain_explanation: This is a direct human acceptance signal for live audio; it is recorded as an observation rather than generalized beyond the witnessed event.

text: Refinement of audio acceptance: live audio occurrence was witnessed, but intelligibility and conversational usefulness remain unconfirmed.
evidence: Admiral direct qualification in Chat Client
captain_explanation: The Admiral distinguished hearing sound from understanding speech; the record preserves both facts without inflating the acceptance claim.

text: Live-audio acceptance is three-level: occurrence, intelligibility, and conversation usefulness; each requires separate human observation.
captain_explanation: The Admiral approved the three-level rule at the Wardroom gate; recording it prevents sound occurrence from being mistaken for successful conversation.

text: Admiral heard a spoken token interpreted as “commit,” but it sounded closer to “comet”; command-word intelligibility remains unconfirmed.
evidence: Admiral direct qualification in Chat Client
captain_explanation: The Captain preserves the heard sound and the Admiral’s uncertainty separately; no command is treated as executed from an ambiguous audio token.

text: LIVE-AUDIO-ACCEPTANCE checklist is approved as the standard human acceptance artifact.
captain_explanation: The Admiral approved the checklist; recording the ruling makes the acceptance levels and their evidence requirements durable.

text: Ambiguous spoken command tokens are observed and confirmed before execution; no consequential action proceeds from uncertain audio.
captain_explanation: The Admiral approved the rule; it converts the observed commit/comet ambiguity into a bounded safety behavior.

text: LIVE-AUDIO-COMMAND-STRESS-TEST is accepted as the standard bounded test packet for spoken command safety.
captain_explanation: The Admiral authorized routine auto-approval for this subthread; the packet is bounded, reversible, and directly tests the already-approved command-safety rule.

text: Admiral typed the bridge-status directive and heard an audio confirmation reference.
evidence: Admiral direct observation in Chat Client
captain_explanation: The Captain records typed-input acceptance and heard response audio separately; this does not yet establish speech-input recognition or full intelligible conversation.
